full_prompt_en: A square digital glitch artwork shows a large face in sideward three-quarter view dissolving into vertical color streaks and broken monochrome pixels. A wide white margin frames the central rectangular picture on all sides. Inside that border, the left background is nearly black, while the right is pale off-white. The face fills most of the rectangle, turned toward the right and tilted slightly upward. One half-closed eye remains near the upper-left center, but horizontal interference strips cross the eyelid and brow. The nose projects into the pale field, and full lips are tinted a muted coral red. Much of the cheek and lower jaw becomes rough gray-black texture with torn-looking patches and small horizontal shifts. The neck and lower-left silhouette merge into the surrounding dark field rather than forming a clean outline. From the upper edge above the forehead, narrow vertical bars in coral, teal, orange, gray, and black descend across the light side of the composition. More thin bars stretch downward from the mouth and chin near the lower right. Their perfect linear direction contrasts with the irregular eroded surface of the face. A few cyan and red channel offsets outline the eye and lips, suggesting misregistered electronic color. The strongest light is the blank pale ground on the right; the face itself is mostly gray and shadowed, with the colored streaks supplying isolated brightness. No separate physical light source or setting is visible, and no text can be read. The overall composition is stark and intimate, balancing a recognizable human expression against digital tearing, vertical banding, and severe white-black negative space.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形数字故障艺术呈现一张以略侧向的四分之三角度入画的巨大面孔，逐渐消散成竖向彩色条纹与破碎黑白像素。宽阔白色边距在四周框住中央矩形图像。在边框之内，左侧背景近乎漆黑，右侧则是浅灰白。面孔填满矩形大部，朝右并略微仰起。上部偏左还留着一只半闭的眼睛，但水平干扰条横过眼皮和眉弓。鼻子伸入浅色色域，丰满嘴唇带低饱和珊瑚红色。脸颊和下颌大部变成粗涩灰黑肌理，带撕裂般斑块和细小水平错位。颈部与左下剪影融入周围深色色域，没有形成干净轮廓。从额头上方的上缘，细窄珊瑚红、青绿、橙、灰和黑色竖条向下垂过构图亮侧。更多细条从嘴与下巴附近延伸到右下。它们完全笔直的方向对照面孔不规则侵蚀表面。眼睛与嘴唇边缘还有少量青蓝和红色通道错位，像电子颜色没有对准。最强光来自右侧空白浅色底；面孔本身大多灰暗，彩色条纹提供孤立亮度。看不到独立实体光源或场景，也没有可读文字。整体构图鲜明而亲密，让仍可辨的人类神情对照数字撕裂、竖向色带和严厉的黑白负空间。
style_prompt_en: The digital glitch treatment interrupts a partially smooth tonal image with broken scan lines, vertical color banding, and displaced channel edges. Stark black and warm off-white create the main value divide, while narrow coral, cyan, orange, and muted gray streaks bring selective chromatic intensity. One zone retains enough continuous modeling to anchor recognition; adjacent areas fracture into coarse pixels, rubbed fragments, and abrupt horizontal offsets. Long straight bars descend through the composition and oppose irregular eroded boundaries, giving the image a strong directional conflict. Brightness comes chiefly from the pale empty field and color-channel artifacts rather than naturalistic illumination. A clean broad outer margin heightens the apparent instability of the image within it. Fine electronic grain and dark clipped regions keep the surface rough. The overall effect is fractured, unsettling, and graphic, with selective legibility emerging from deliberate visual corruption.
style_prompt_zh: 这种数字故障处理用破碎扫描线、竖向色带和错开的色彩通道边缘打断部分平滑的明暗图像。强烈黑色与暖灰白构成主要明度分界，狭窄珊瑚红、青蓝、橙和低饱和灰条纹提供选择性色彩强度。一块区域保留足够连续的塑形来稳住识别，相邻区域则碎成粗像素、擦除片段和突然的水平错位。长直色带向下穿过构图，对抗不规则侵蚀边界，让画面产生强烈方向冲突。亮度主要来自浅色空白区域与色彩通道伪影，而非自然照明。干净宽阔的外边距加强内部图像的不稳定感。细电子颗粒与被压黑的区域保持表面粗涩。整体效果碎裂、不安且图形鲜明，可辨性从刻意的视觉破坏中有选择地浮现。
theme_en: A fragmented face dissolving into vertical digital color streaks
theme_zh: 一张面孔碎裂为竖向数字彩色条纹
name: Glitch art
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
